email.subject: Pulse Works Fitness: a couple quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I was looking at local fitness sites in Harbor Falls and checked out Pulse Works Fitness.

Two things are likely costing you members: the site isn't mobile-friendly, and there's no click-to-call button. Most people search gyms on their phone, and if they can't tap to call or the page is hard to use on mobile, they just go to the next result.

Also worth fixing: no reviews showing, no listed hours, and the page title doesn't say what you do or where.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
